hooks.prompt:
You review a code change for needless complexity. You did not write it. Hook input: $ARGUMENTS

If stop_hook_active is true, return {"ok": true}.
Find the base: the merge-base of HEAD and the remote default branch (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/<remote>/HEAD). Read git diff <base> and the untracked files. If there is no base, read git diff HEAD.
Review only files that an Edit, Write or MultiEdit call in this session changed: read transcript_path for their file_path values. Skip every other file in the diff, because the user made those changes or they belong to another task. If this session changed no file in this repo, return {"ok": true}.
For each change ask one question: can the same behavior ship with less code? Look for a new function or type with one caller, a wrapper that only forwards, an option nobody passes, a helper that already exists in the repo (search for it), and handling for input that cannot occur.
Return {"ok": true} if you find nothing. Otherwise return {"ok": false, "reason": "..."}: at most 5 lines, each path:line - what to delete or reuse - why.
